title: Travel: John Lennon – Tokyo to Kyoto | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono travelled from Tokyo to Kyoto in Japan on 18 January 1971.

They were accompanied on the trip by Japanese music journalist Junichi Yano, who took a number of photographs of the couple in Kyoto. They included Lennon buying a wooden sword, and both of them wearing kimonos outside Enryaku-ji, a Tendai monastery located on Mount Hiei in Ōtsu.
